newsitem.title: USA: Kinnard unit's Q3 revenues off 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kinnard unit's Q3 revenues off 13 pct.

text.p: Kinnard Investments Inc said third-quarter revenues at its John G. Kinnard subsidiary declined 13 percent in part to lower transaction levels.
During the quarter, the company said it managed an $11.5 million private financing for Excelsior Henderson Inc, which is developing a new American-made motorcycle.

Kinnard Investments also said during the first nine months of the year it purchased and retired about 290,000 shares of its common stock. At September 30 it had repurchased 548,000 of the 1.1 million shares authorized under a stock buyback program.
Earlier, Kinnard Investments reported third-quarter earnings of $0.19 per share, up from $0.18 per share a year ago. Revenues were $21.5 million in both periods.
